title: The 12 Gods of Greek Mythology: Zeus, Poseidon, Hades, Hera, Demeter, Hestia, Athena, Apollo, Artemis, Hephaestus, Aphrodite and Ares
notes: Compilation serije Greek Gods: sva četiri dela u jednom videu. Priča svakog dela ostaje, a rekap na početku nastavaka (Part 2 S01–S09, Part 3 nema rekap osim jedne uvodne rečenice, Part 4 S01–S03) i outro sa end karticom (od outro_start-a) otpadaju. Spojevi: Part 1→2 koristi Part 2 S02 („Their three sisters were never given a lot.“) preko prelaznog still-a kacige i tri senke; Part 2→3 je direktan rez; Part 3→4 koristi Part 4 S02 („Hera could not stop a child born from her husband's head.“) preko Herinog besa (shot03). Sastavljeno alatom tools/compile.mjs, montaža assemble.mjs.
